name: next-steps
description: After each real turn, suggests 1-3 next prompts in a pane of their own: tick any number and insert them into the prompt box together. The text sent for the suggestion is scrubbed of personal data (IDs, phones, emails, cards).

model.title: Suggestion model
model.description: The model that writes the suggestions.

minAnswerChars.title: Minimum answer length
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after shorter answers, unless the turn made 3 or more tool calls.
